description.intro: The Puma Girona Essentials cap is the perfect accessory to show your passion for your team. Its design combines comfort and style, becoming an essential basic for any fan.

Versatile design: Adapts to different occasions of daily use.
Guaranteed comfort: Light and practical to wear throughout the day.
